caseNameFull: Van Lare, Acting Commissioner, Department of Social Services of New York v. Hurley

opinions.text: Appear from D. C. S. D. N. Y. and D. C. E. D. N. Y. Application for stay presented to Mr. Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted and case set for oral argument with No. 74-5054 [Taylor v. Lavine, certiorari granted, infra].
